PR #245 is now marked ready and mergeable, and carries the `verified` label. Head is `a79eee3f11`.

- **Why the previous attempt didn't finish:** attempt 4 stopped on purpose to wait for the 3-run verdict. That verdict landed at 18:03Z, but the handback job only resumes a lane once per branch head, and it had already used this head. So nothing resumed the lane until the host did it by hand. This is recorded in NOTES; lane.handbackstrand owns the fix.
- **Verdict:** the arms job judged the 3-run check a PASS, 403 of 403, which supersedes the earlier single-run FAIL. I checked both arms before trusting it: every score file has 404 rows with none `unreadable`, and no log reports PARTIAL COVERAGE. One `UtilAcceptVsock` error appears in each arm, but no capture was lost. The 4 GeometrySuperscreen movers in the single-run FAIL were device noise.
- **Merge:** I merged master @ `2b04d4d422` without rebasing. The only conflict was `nv2a_index.json`. I took master's copy and rebuilt it over the pinned tests tree @ 6743b6a and pbkitplusplus @ e91d509, and `check` with both trees says it matches. All four prediction refs are still ancestors of the head.
- **Definition of done:** preflight passes, and NOTES has an attempt 5 section. The PR body was updated through the REST API and read back: the `Files:` line matches the five paths in the diff, and there is a new results section.
- **Still open:** CI on the new head `a79eee3f11` has just been queued and has not reported yet. #255 (negative subnormals coming back as +0) is left for its own lane, as the brief says.
